Counts reflect stored labels. Repetitions with invalid or incomplete landmarks are excluded during feature extraction, so the final training sample count may be lower. Only good and bad knee-alignment labels are trainable; borderline, unassessable, disputed, and missing labels are reported but excluded.

FPPA v2 Feature Schema
Six fixed inputs used by the current M1 model.
✓
Left FPPA at squat bottom
Signed left knee angle at squat bottom.
✓
Right FPPA at squat bottom
Signed right knee angle at squat bottom.
✓
Left peak FPPA
Largest absolute filtered left FPPA in the repetition.
✓
Right peak FPPA
Largest absolute filtered right FPPA in the repetition.
✓
Bottom bilateral asymmetry
Absolute left-right FPPA difference at squat bottom.
✓
Peak bilateral asymmetry
Absolute left-right difference between peak FPPA values.

The fixed schema keeps training inputs aligned with frontal-plane FPPA assessment and model provenance.

Current Model
The FPPA M1 experiment uses a fixed XGBoost classifier.
XGB
XGBoost · FPPA M1
Predicts human-reviewed good/bad knee-alignment labels from the fixed FPPA v2 feature schema.

M0 uses four FPPA features; M1 adds bilateral asymmetry. Both are XGBoost models. The fixed 10-degree threshold rule is evaluated separately on the M0 / M1 Results page.

Training Parameters
